before.name: InTime Solutions
before.description: Scheduling and workforce management for police, corrections, and 911

competitors.why: Both sell cloud shift scheduling to the same police, sheriff, corrections and dispatch workforce buyer; a scheduling sergeant evaluates one instead of the other.
Vector's scheduling and readiness suite competes directly for the same public safety staffing/scheduling contract InTime bids.

paragraphs: InTime sells scheduling software for public safety agencies, built for police, sheriff departments, fire, corrections, and dispatch. The company says it has helped over 500 public safety agencies manage daily scheduling and operations for over 25 years. The head office is in Vancouver, BC.

Beyond shift coverage, the software handles agency leave requests, timebank management, approvals and vacation scheduling. A court and subpoena module adds court appearances to officer schedules, serves electronic subpoenas and communicates with witnesses. Asset tracking assigns vehicles, radios, laptops and firearms to qualified and trained officers.

Anaheim Police Department began using InTime in 2006, replacing spreadsheets for patrol scheduling. That department reports patrol scheduling time falling from about eight hours per cycle to fifteen minutes. Customer data is hosted by Amazon Web Services.

quote.text: Scheduling software built for public safety.

provenance.quote: InTime is designed to make scheduling easier for police, sheriff departments, fire, corrections, and dispatch.
InTime draws expertise from helping over 500+ public safety agencies in managing their daily scheduling and operations for over 25 years.
Based in Vancouver, BC.
Streamline agency leave requests, timebank management, approvals and vacation scheduling.
Easily add court appearances into your officer’s schedules, serve electronic subpoenas and efficiently communicate with witnesses.
Use InTime to assign vehicles, radios, laptops, firearms and more to qualified and trained officers.
The department began using InTime in 2006 through the ILJ group across Orange County police agencies, replacing spreadsheets for patrol scheduling.
Patrol scheduling time was reduced from approximately eight hours per cycle to fifteen minutes
All InTime customer data is hosted by Amazon Web Services (AWS) in secure data centers.

before.name: MSAB
before.description: XRY/XAMN mobile device forensics for law enforcement and military

competitors.why: UFED mobile device extraction and analysis, the primary alternative to XRY for the same police digital forensics unit
Graykey and Axiom phone extraction and examination bought instead of XRY/XAMN by the same forensic lab
Mobile and cloud device forensics software competing for the same examiner seat license budget
Field digital forensic triage software competing with XRY Express for the same patrol/investigator field-extraction rollout

paragraphs: MSAB builds mobile device forensics software, and XRY lets forensic experts and frontline users recover data from phones while maintaining evidential integrity. XAMN handles the analysis side, searching, filtering and visualizing hundreds of gigabytes of mobile data for use in a judicial setting. XEC manages the operation itself, updating forensic software instantly and reporting on team performance.

The stated buyers are law enforcement agencies that want to speed up investigations and eliminate device backlogs. MSAB also sells screening capability to customs and border security. The company says it has over 4,000 customers worldwide.

MSAB Office is the all-in-one package that installs on any Windows based computer, and MSAB Field is the ruggedized version supplied with a Toughbook computer. The MSAB Kiosk is a turnkey unit that lets users with minimal training process many devices from a fixed location. XRY Pro extracts and decodes data from devices that are locked or encrypted.

quote.text: The .xry file format is forensically secure

provenance.quote: XRY enables both forensic experts and frontline users to recover more critical data in less time, all while maintaining full evidential integrity.
Search, filter, review, visualize and analyze hundreds of gigabytes of mobile data effectively for use in a judicial setting.
Manage mobile forensics, improve the performance of your team, instantly update forensic software, monitor and report on operations.
They can allow you to speed up investigations, eliminate device backlogs and increase efficiency.
We provide customs and border security with effective screening capabilities.
Trusted by over 4,000 customers worldwide
MSAB Field is the ruggedized version of MSAB Office. It is supplied with a Toughbook computer.

The MSAB Kiosk allows organizations to decentralize their mobile forensic operation and scale their extraction power by enabling users with minimal training to process many devices from a fixed location.
It helps you extract and decode more data from mobile devices, even when they are locked or encrypted.

before.name: Skydio
before.description: Autonomous drones for police DFR programs and public-sector inspection - exhibited at NLC City Summit 2026

competitors.why: 911-response drones staged on police rooftops: same DFR aircraft decision at the same department
DFR software and hardware auto-launching to 911 calls: direct alternative for the same program
Aerodome drone-as-first-responder sold to the same PD launching a DFR program
DFR program software and turnkey operations competing for the same department DFR contract
Autonomous responder drones for first responder situational awareness, same buyer and mission

paragraphs: Skydio makes autonomous drones, along with the docks and software to run them, and sells drone programs to customers from energy networks to neighborhood precincts to battlefields. Those programs cover Drone as First Responder, automated inspection and site security. Dock for X10 positions Skydio X10 drones at a site so that missions launch remotely without anyone present. The smaller Skydio R10 puts eyes indoors before officers enter.

Skydio states that more than 1,500 public safety agencies use its drones. In a Drone as First Responder program, Skydio says its drones launch in under 20 seconds and reach incidents autonomously in under 90 seconds. DFR Command is the software from which remote operators launch and manage drones, respond to multiple calls and stream live video to patrol and command. It integrates with RapidSOS and CAD at dispatch, Axon Fusus for live operations, and automatic evidence upload into Axon Evidence. Skydio's customer stories include Brookhaven PD, which it says reached 30 second response times after deploying 8 Docks.

Skydio Site Security uses the same dock-based drones to verify alarms, patrol perimeters and deliver live visibility across a site. Video streams into Genetec or Milestone, and flights launch automatically when triggered by alarms or access control events. Skydio says its data is encrypted in transit and at rest and that it aligns to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks.
